description: This is a Java source file defining an Android Activity class ShowActivity, which displays detailed information about a particular activity component, such as its package, icon, class name, label, launch mode, process name, task affinity, permissions, and various flags. It accesses Android framework classes to retrieve activity info and populates UI elements with this data.

classes.name: ShowActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays detailed information about a specified activity component, including its icon, label, package, class name, launch mode, permissions, and flags.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, retrieves activity info from the intent data, and populates UI elements with the activity's properties.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onResume lifecycle method; currently, it only calls super.onResume().
